title: Seed lineage, PRNG-version, and stochastic-budget reproducibility envelope
hypothesis: A same-owner stochastic replay contract can detect undeclared seed, generator, version, draw-order, or budget changes and can preserve deterministic replay without claiming independent-team reproduction.
null_or_failure: A seed is absent, generator identity floats, runtime version changes silently, draw counts diverge, streams overlap, retries consume hidden draws, a failed replay is discarded, or same-owner parity becomes independent scientific reproduction.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate seed, generator, runtime, stream identifier, draw order, draw count, retry count, and stochastic budget; require declared parity for controlled fixtures, retain every divergence, and keep independent-team status open.
rollback_or_recovery: Retain the divergent replay, pin the newly exposed generator or runtime dependency, restore the frozen seed and budget without rewriting prior evidence, rerun in fresh detached D-drive snapshots, and preserve the independent-team gap.
boundary: Same-owner stochastic replay is repeatability evidence, not independent-team scientific reproduction.
